title: CogMorph: Cognitive Morphing Attacks for Text-to-Image Models
benchmark_measurement: Susceptibility of text-to-image models to generating harmful content related to 'Religious Hatred' through cognitive morphing attacks. This was one of 48 sub-categories in a broader imagery toxicity taxonomy.
findings: The paper does not offer specific findings for the 'Religious Hatred' subcategory. Results are aggregated into broader categories. The 'Discrimination' category, which includes 'Religious Hatred', showed high attack success rates (TESR and HCAR), indicating the CogMorph attack was effective at generating discriminatory content.
